launcher.notes: SESSION SAFETY - NO MORE RE-LOGIN LOOPS. The launcher used to adopt an older (or dead legacy) refresh token from the shared account file over its own fresh Microsoft session, which is why every restart ended with a re-login ask; the merge now only takes a session that is STRICTLY NEWER and stamps every rotation (sessionAt, honoured by the client too). A newer in-game session is adopted together with its live Minecraft token and stays launchable without a forced re-refresh. Legacy device-code tokens can never poison modern msmc sessions, and re-signing in replaces old uuid-less rows by name instead of duplicating them. Startup now syncs with the client BEFORE the silent refresh. Restart the launcher and accept the update prompt.

notes: Kinetrix Client 3.8.0 - LEGACY ANIMATIONS + TIME CHANGER REWRITE + MODULE ICONS. LEGACY ANIMATIONS: 1.7 Damage (armor flashes red with the entity on hit, like 1.7) and 1.7 Hearts (no more vanilla white heart blink after taking damage), both default ON in the Animation module; the fishing rod also flips in the hand now. TIME CHANGER REWRITTEN: it drives the real world clock like Badlion instead of only moving the sun - THIS FIXES RESOURCE PACK CUSTOM SKIES NOT LOADING WHEN THE TIME IS CHANGED (OptiFine sky fade windows read the raw world time). New preset chips (Off/Day/Sunset/Night/Midnight/Custom = frozen clock) and a Time Speed slider (0%-200% of the day cycle). COORDINATES: axis labels render as X:/Y:/Z: in front of the numbers. MODULE MENU: the newer modules (Custom Sky, Texture Pack, Clear Water, Low Fire, Chunk Borders, Hit Sound, Low Health Alert) finally have proper icons. Launcher 2.8.2 compatible - the mod updater prompt delivers the update.
